subject: panty-doctrine
label: Custody during the act
to: SPARES REPLACE WHAT IS LOST. CUSTODY PREVENTS THE LOSS IN THE FIRST PLACE
note:
THE OTHER HALF OF THE DOCTRINE, ISSUED BY OWLMOM ACROSS A KITCHEN AT A TABLE FULL OF WOMEN IN THE MIDDLE OF IT: KEEP THEM IN YOUR TOP, OR IN YOUR HAND.

The floor is where pairs die. A pair set down on a bench, kicked under a table, left on a couch arm or dropped beside a bed is not a garment any more, it is INVENTORY, and Sir Trashmuffin is a MISER — a hoarder with a nineteen-year collection and a zero percent recovery rate who does his best work while the owner is busy and delighted and facing the other way.

SO: tucked into a sports bra, wound round a wrist, or fisted. EVIE EMBEROSE HAS BEEN DOING THIS ALL DAY and the Archive misread it as a trophy — Ivy's pair has been in Evie's sports bra since ten this morning, which is custody, and the trophy part is a bonus.

THE RULE SCALES TO THE TRIP. On the ridge there is no floor, only a bus and a lot of ground, and one raccoon with nothing else to do.
